Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, t As ListObject
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "Sheet1"
    ws.Activate
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("Name", "Qty", "Price")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 1, 2.5)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 2, 3.5)
    ws.Range("A4:C4").Value = Array("c", 3, 4.5)
    Set t = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:C4"), , xlYes)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 1
        ws.Range("E1").Select
        Tried = t.Active
    Case 2
        ws.Range("B2").Select
        Tried = t.Active
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1:E1").Select
        Tried = t.Active
    Case 4
        t.Comment = "Note here"
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\comment.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\comment.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 5
        t.AlternativeText = "Alt words"
        t.Summary = "Longer summary"
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\alt.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\alt.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 6
        t.AlternativeText = "Alt only"
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\alt_only.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\alt_only.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 7
        t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown = False
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\dropdown.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\dropdown.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 8
        t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown = False
        t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown = True
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\dropdown_back.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\dropdown_back.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 9
        t.ShowAutoFilter = False
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 10
        t.ShowAutoFilter = False
        t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown = True
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 11
        t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown = False
        t.ShowAutoFilter = False
        t.ShowAutoFilter = True
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 12
        t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown = False
        t.Range.AutoFilter 1, "a"
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\dropdown_filtered.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\dropdown_filtered.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 13
        t.Comment = "x"
        t.Comment = ""
        Tried = t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\comment_cleared.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\comment_cleared.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & t.SourceType & "/" & t.Comment & "/" & t.AlternativeText & "/" & t.Summary & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilter & "/" & t.ShowAutoFilterDropDown & "/" & TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.DisplayRightToLeft & "/" & t.Slicers.Count & "/" & TypeName(t.Application) & "/" & TypeName(t.Slicers)
    Case 14
        t.Comment = String(300, "c")
        Tried = Len(t.Comment)
    Case 15
        t.Comment = 12
        Tried = TypeName(t.Comment) & "/" & t.Comment
    Case 16
        t.Delete
        Set t = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:C1"), , xlYes)
        Tried = TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.InsertRowRange.Address & "/" & t.ListRows.Count & "/" & t.Range.Address
    Case 17
        t.Delete
        Set t = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:C2"), , xlYes)
        Tried = TypeName(t.InsertRowRange) & "/" & t.ListRows.Count
    Case 18
        t.Refresh
        Tried = "done"
    Case 19
        Tried = TypeName(t.QueryTable)
    Case 20
        t.Unlink
        Tried = "done"
    Case 21
        Tried = t.SharePointURL
    Case 22
        Tried = TypeName(t.XmlMap)
    Case 23
        Tried = TypeName(t.TableObject)
    Case 24
        ws.DisplayRightToLeft = True
        Tried = t.DisplayRightToLeft
    Case 25
        t.AlternativeText = 7
        Tried = TypeName(t.AlternativeText) & "/" & t.AlternativeText
    Case 26
        t.Comment = String(255, "c")
        Tried = Len(t.Comment)
    Case 27
        t.Comment = String(256, "c")
        Tried = Len(t.Comment)
    Case 28
        t.AlternativeText = String(300, "a")
        t.Summary = String(300, "s")
        Tried = Len(t.AlternativeText) & "/" & Len(t.Summary)
    Case 29
        ws.Range("A1:E1").Select
        ws.Range("E1").Activate
        Tried = ActiveCell.Address & "/" & t.Active
    Case 30
        ws.Range("E1:F2").Select
        ws.Range("E1").Activate
        Tried = t.Active
    Case 31
        ws.Range("B2").Select
        wb.Worksheets.Add
        Tried = t.Active
    Case 32
        t.Comment = "a" & vbLf & "b"
        Tried = Len(t.Comment)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\comment_line.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\comment_line.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        Set t = ws.ListObjects(1)
        Tried = Tried & " @ " & Len(t.Comment)
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = Tried & "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 32
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
